findings.title: Windows绝对路径未按cwd缩短，长前缀吞掉工具摘要中的文件名
findings.aliasDisposition: Root111 initial deferred lead; independent113 targeted source review and sameRoot114 contract check support one issue, not additional findings.
findings.validation: Static code and repository platform/input contract only; independently reviewed. No Windows/CLI/TTY/helper/test/FS/native execution; Desktop release matrix is support background, not CLI runtime acceptance.
findings.condition: Native Windows path semantics, ordinary absolute file_path under process.cwd(), such as two different ASCII paths sharing a valid cwd prefix longer than the60character display budget.
findings.expected: The helper documented cwd-relative display keeps the differentiating relative path visible.
findings.actual: relativizePath returns immediately for values not starting withslash; native Windows drive-letter absolute paths skip cwd-prefix removal. formatToolArgs then truncates the remaining absolute path to60characters, so sufficiently long shared cwd hides different relative filenames in both actual TUI/CLI args displays.
findings.impact: Tool-start argument summaries retain an unnecessary absolute prefix and may show identical truncated paths for different files. No claim incorrect file access, lost source bytes, all paths, actual Windows frames or full CLI platform certification.
counterevidence: Ordinary POSIX absolute paths have a leading slash and reach the prefix-removal branch.
Alreadyrelative or short absolute paths do not establish the hidden-filename condition.
Paths outsidecwd intentionally remain unchanged and are not this trigger.
R14UTF16 truncation is a separate old mechanism; this example usesASCII only.
findings.deduplication: Independent113 fresh5150originalMD/recursiveJSONvalue history inclarchive and focused Windows+toolDisplay/path shortening cause; Root114 directly checks platform badge, Desktop-matrix qualifier, nativepath import and ordinary absolute input boundary. KnownR14Unicode relation/failedfixture excluded. No first-ever/full unique or exhaustive history absence claim.
findings.fixDirection: Recognize native absolute paths using the platform path API and remove an actual cwd containment prefix before truncation, preserving relative/outsidecwd behavior.
